title: Qwen3.6-27B post-GDN fixed-weight and untracked-memory audit

protocol.accepted_rows: Retained selector-unset 59fd48631 package, token 9707, one warmup plus three measured persistent resets, bulk prefill, BF16 KV, graph decode, 128 transitions, cached builds, and 5-ms whole-device sampling.
protocol.hip_phase: hipMemGetInfo at explicit phase boundaries; adjusted below by subtracting both tracked ownership and the clean 64913408-byte card baseline.
protocol.whole_device: sysfs VRAM peak minus the same clean pre-process baseline.
protocol.planner: Replay the production conflict, subrange, 64-KiB color-gap, and alignment predicates with both the existing descending-size order and a deterministic descending-total-live-stage-duration order. Select the latter only when its arena is smaller.

fixed_weight_ownership.conclusion: The fixed payload is real model data, not allocator fragmentation. It is already packed into one 849-view immutable arena plus one deliberately aligned large owner; only 0.615 MiB is padding. Reopening dual/raw layouts, changing quantization, or sacrificing the large-owner alignment is not a byte-backed exact candidate.

untracked_owner_exclusions.aotriton: Already isolated at 512: disabling AOTriton saved only 1.156 MiB whole-device with identical tracked/steady HIP use.

rocblas_4096.decision: not the owner and not retainable

untracked_owner_exclusions.graph_transport: The prior paired 8K eager diagnostic saved 133.055 MiB but lost 18.75% decode; it remains required.

loaded_hipengine_modules_after_4096_pref.conclusion: The loaded hipEngine JIT file set is too small to explain a 444-447-MiB long-row transient gap; module-unload work remains unselected.

untracked_owner_exclusions.conclusion: The stable 162-166-MiB post-load process cost and phase/transient driver-library residency are real, but the tested removable surfaces contribute only single-digit MiB or violate the speed gate. No honest fixed-owner contraction large enough for parity is currently identified.

liveness_order_candidate.mechanism: Keep every allocation, pointer ABI, lifetime, subrange, color gap, and kernel unchanged. Compute both the existing size-first greedy placement and a live-stage-duration-first placement, retaining the smaller deterministic plan.
liveness_order_candidate.why_selected: This is the only newly identified exact, byte-backed, non-duplicative owner. It is allocator-only, reaches within 0.625 MiB of the measured long-row live-clique floor, and needs no new kernel or persistent payload.
liveness_order_candidate.acceptance: Retain only if deterministic overlap tests pass and clean selector-unset 512/8K prefill/decode plus whole-device memory are non-regressive. It is incremental and cannot close the remaining Vulkan gap alone.

decision: Keep the Vulkan memory objective open. Do not reopen fixed-weight layout, AOTriton, rocBLAS-disable, graph-disable, or module-unload lanes. Implement and screen the deterministic lower-of-size-first/live-duration-first liveness planner next; its modeled 28.6875-MiB long-row reduction is incremental, not parity.
